purpose: T1, the workshop->engine asset wire: released workshop creatures join the evolution founder pool through the engine's own gates, and their lineages are traced through every generation — the og promise that user-authored assets influence evolution, measured.

decision.reason: Archive elites reproduce: every creature in every generation validates, survives repeated damage/repair cycles with full episodes between regenerations, stays SLIP-aligned, and scores back into the archive; ancestry deepens generation over generation. Fitness and archive trajectories are reported as measurements, not gates. Under the stress regime, episode death is a legitimate measured outcome (see death_count and the per-generation load/survival trajectories), never a contract failure.

next_research_step: With survival now morphology-dependent, study whether selection climbs (mean stress load / survival by generation) over longer horizons, then give the learning module this regime as its evaluation environment (decision record 0009 candidate).
